name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN–army fighting in Kivus; no city fallen
summary: Army and Kabila-led FRN keep fighting in North and South Kivu; no major city has fallen as of 28 Nov
state: FRN fighters advanced through Kahuzi-Biega National Park from 6–7 Nov and reportedly took Bitale and Bulambika on National Route 3 in South Kivu; the army says it halted the advance at Bulambika and is preparing a counter-attack (Afrik.com, 10 Nov). A humanitarian alert of 9 Nov counted about 166,500 newly displaced. Searches on 28 Nov found no capture of a major city and no confirmed direct interstate fighting, so Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to much of eastern DR Congo. Civilians in North and South Kivu are most exposed; fighting along main roads tends to cut supply routes, displace villages and disrupt health services.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting (FRN–army clashes in South Kivu); no major city captured, no direct interstate fighting confirmed
